findings.issue: On partial move failure, Restore demands stash roots equal all rooms; already-moved rooms cannot recover and the initiating exception is replaced. NewScene and active-scene mutation are outside try. Restore also cannot retry after a partial restoration.
findings.fix: Reconcile recorded rooms across original and stash with exact unique inventory, restore whichever were moved, make progress retryable, retain initial and recovery exceptions; cover scene creation and active-scene mutation.

findings.fix: Capture actual global lighting state and retained renderer baked/realtime indices+scale offsets immediately before reloading stash, verify after reattachment/closing or restore explicitly. Validate active original LightingDataAsset.

findings.issue: Renderer scale offsets/realtime indices, nonempty property blocks, light inner cone/area/bounce values omitted from exact-state claim.
findings.fix: Add these supported states or reject unsupported nonempty overrides.

findings.issue: Recovery scene saved after room deactivation/front-end muting; it preserves full geometry but is not original all-active delivery.
findings.fix: Preserve a separate exact pre-mutation full scene or explicitly bind/restorable original activation/renderer state in recovery proof.
